degree_rationale: How the cosmos was built from death's poured-forth corpses, with the Twelve Dignities and the twelve zodiac-correspondences. This treats the essential genesis of the dark cosmos as a structural counter-image.
direction_rationale: Illumines the structural twelvefold mystery of the dark cosmos seen against the light — wisdom showing how the kinds, the spirits of error, the zodiac-prisons mirror the First Man's humbling.
grand_man_function: Celestial twelvefold counter-illumination — the dark cosmos as seen by wisdom.
title: How the cosmos was built from death's poured corpses / The Twelve Dignities
